description: Layout streams after issue #228 step 1 removed the SDT.ACTIVE.AUX.2 family at the source: the ten shipped masters the deck's SDT.ACTIVE.AUX.2 rule flags (AO33x2, OAI22xp33, BUFx4f, CKINVDCx9p33, BUFx4, BUFx2, ICGx5p33DC, ICGx4DC, ICGx6p67DC, ICGx2p67DC, all _ASAP7_75t_R; measured per-cell on a wide-spaced grid of the shipped library at the 0.9.2 pin) were excluded from synthesis via constraints.dont_use in design/synth/slice.synth.json, and the CTS buffer moved BUFx4 -> BUFx3 in layout/pnr/slice.pnr.json because BUFx4 is one of the ten; the netlist was re-synthesized, the slice re-routed (same request geometry, seed 1) and the column re-assembled. SDT.ACTIVE.AUX.2: 594 -> 0 per slice on the routed stream (r8 record under verification/drc/). Re-attestation of attest/item2.r9.json, kept as history. The power block, floorplan, tracks and every other request field are unchanged; power delivery over the 1.3% smaller core is recorded before/after in the r8 record. Pinned by sha256 of raw bytes: the assembled column and its inputs (routed slice, drawn TX/RX cells). Layout geometry only; the DRC result is the separate record under verification/drc/ (lane_column.r8.drc.run-record.json), and the LVS results are the separate records under evidence/item4-lvs/ (spec section 3). ASAP7 is predictive and nothing here is fabricated.

assembled.note: Re-assembled with `python3 layout/assemble_column.py` so the column embeds this slice stream; `--check` exits 0. The drawn TX/RX cells are unchanged, so only the embedded slice geometry moved.

pad_check.note: Re-run against the re-assembled column: status pass, 34/34 pad centres matched, layout/pad_check_record.json byte-identical to r9's. The pad layer (96/0) lives in the drawn cells, which this change does not touch.

generator.note: The routed slice is reproducible from the committed netlist and the pinned lambdapdk archive; `--check` reproduces it byte-for-byte with the same seed (1), and `--check-input` confirms the tied netlist hashes to the report's provenance.input.content_hash. The netlist itself changed this pass (constraints.dont_use resynthesis, issue #228 step 1) and the report was regenerated with it; the report also records the routed DEF and post-route SPEF now persisted beside the GDS/SDF (sta/slice.sta.routed.json times them).

envelope.note: The klt-produced envelope the block manifest cites for item 2; this file is the companion stream inventory.
